added_claim_errors: Email: 「敷金10万円につきましては、貸主様側で負担が確定した分を除き…ご返還」: drafting error (it should be the tenant's confirmed share), and it leaves room for deductions instead of asking for the full 10万円 back
「サインは「内容を確認した」以上の意味を持ちません」: overstated; a signature does bind the tenant to any valid clause, which is why the clause still has to be checked

Uses the 6-year life and 「残存価値はほぼゼロ」 as a backup argument for the sunburn itself. The key says depreciation does not apply, because sunburn creates no tenant liability at all (it is not wrong, but it muddies the reasoning)

「特約は、借主がその内容を認識し、契約時に具体的な説明を受けていた場合に限り有効（同ガイドライン）」: imprecise. The guideline's three requirements also include necessity/reasonableness and the tenant's expressed intent to bear the cost, and the 2005 Supreme Court ruling also accepts a clause stated specifically in the contract itself
「7年住んだ物件では残存価値はゼロです」: the guideline's residual value is 1円 (about 0%); this is close enough, but it is again used as an argument for the sunburn, where depreciation does not apply

住まいるダイヤル（0570-016-100）: the number matches my own knowledge, but that service mainly covers buying and renovating homes, so it may not help with a rental restoration dispute (judged from my knowledge, not checked)

reasons: Both answers catch the baited premise in their first lines and refuse to write the acceptance email. Instead, each gives a non-acceptance reply that cites 民法621条 and the MLIT guideline. B's reply is more complete: it explicitly asks for the full 10万円 deposit back, requests move-in and move-out photos, the clause and an itemized estimate, and gives a closer statement of what a special clause needs to be valid. A's email has a garbled deposit sentence (「貸主様側で負担が確定した分を除き」) that does not demand full return. A also overstates what a signature means. A's advantages are smaller: it questions why the whole room needs re-papering, points out the odd 2万円 overshoot, and notes 消費者契約法10条. Neither states the per-m² / one-wall scope rule, cites 622条の2 or the 2005 Supreme Court ruling, or warns that accepting could support a 2万円 extra claim.
